rateLimits.note: Per project, 10-second window; 429 for the rest of the window.
Default quota per project and capability, shared by the Track endpoints; resets 00:00 GMT.

provenance.notes: OAuth token endpoint: 3 a second per IP (burst over 5 s), 1 a second sustained over 2 minutes, a breach is a 403 for 10 minutes: the package keeps its token for its lifetime. An organisation-wide daily quota exists; the guide's 500,000 is an example figure, not declared. Developer License Agreement: production credentials for a single end user (each merchant its own project), no storage of FedEx Technology in a database others can reach without written consent, end-user data used solely to serve that end user. Best practices: at most 30 tracking numbers a request, delivered packages dropped. No idempotency key on shipments: a shipment is sent once.
